About Seven Stars Seven Stars Rent A Car has been serving the vehicular hire and transport needs of individuals and businesses for a quarter of a century. Established in 1991, a team of 8 people has grown into Abu Dhabi’s preferred rental and transport partner for global brands and local businesses. Today, Seven Stars Rent A Car employs over 400 people and manages a fleet of 1200 plus vehicles. Seven Stars Rent A Car has a superb track record of robust long-term business relationships with extremely reputable companies. We have been providing rental, leasing, transport and fleet services to a roster of international clients that includes the American Air force and French, German and Indian navies. We are also regular transport and rental partners for the IDEX exhibition in Abu Dhabi. With 5 branches already in operation, an expansion programme will see Seven Stars Rent A Car increase its reach through 3 new outlets by 2017.
